viewing_check: Look for maker names on die stock, tap wrench and dies (e.g. Whitworth, Moore & Wright, Eclipse, Britannia, Greenfield, Patience & Nicholson, Wells); thread type (BSW/BSF/Whitworth vs metric); count of taps and dies present; rust severity; whether brass wrench is stamped.
